column.deltaHint: Change against the previous round. A large jump matters even when the value is still within limits.

index.title: Measurements
index.subtitle: Pick the service to see what it measures and which trains it applies to.
index.empty: No train has readings of this service
index.formatHint: What this service records at each point. Its evidence is {{evidence}}.
index.noMagnitudes: This service has no magnitudes configured
index.noMagnitudesHint: Create them in Settings → Measurement types.
index.lastInterventionHint: The most recent date anyone intervened on the train: a visit of any service, or maintenance.

trend.subtitle: Point × date matrix, the same shape as the customer's trend sheet.
trend.hint: Each cell is tinted with the status that reading got. An empty dot is a round that does not exist; a dash is a round that could not be measured.
trend.emptyBody: They will appear once the first visit is recorded.

record.title: Record of values
record.saveFailed: Some column could not be saved
record.legend: One row per point, one column per round. Only open rounds you performed can be edited; the padlock marks the closed ones. Clearing a cell means “could not be measured”, not zero.
record.notFound: That equipment does not exist or is out of your reach.
record.ungradedHint: No standard: no threshold judges this magnitude, so the value has no status colour.
record.noSchematic: No schematic yet. The drawing of the train with its points marked.
record.noSitePhoto: No photo yet. A real photograph of the installed train.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.subtitle: What each round is taken with, and when its calibration expires
instruments.name: Name
instruments.newHint: A reading taken with an expired instrument cannot be defended

spectra.title: Train spectra
spectra.subtitle: Every point of the train, in train order. Open one to see the capture and edit its finding.
spectra.emptyHint: Upload the image the software exports, the CSV, or both.
spectra.importHint: Upload the image the software exports (for instance SKF's waterfall), the CSV, or both.
spectra.fileHint: SEMAPI or SKF CSV: two columns, frequency and amplitude
spectra.captureHint: PNG or JPG as the software exports it
spectra.needOne: Upload at least a capture or a data file
spectra.findingHint: What it shows. In the report, the text under the capture.

capture.title: Round capture · {{equipment}}
capture.subtitle: Order {{order}}
capture.gridHint: A blank cell is recorded as not measured, with its reason
capture.nothingHint: This machine has no active points, or the order's technique measures nothing
capture.notOnPoint: This point does not read this magnitude in the round

chart.title: Trends
chart.hint: Pick what to compare; up to {{max}} at a time
chart.pickOne: Pick a point to see its trend
chart.togglePoint: Point {{point}}: all three axes at once
chart.markerHint: Dashed line: corrective maintenance closed that day.

thermogram.title: Upload thermogram
thermogram.hint: One thermogram per element observed. If a FLIR camera took the image, the maximum temperature proposes itself.
thermogram.tmaxHint: Leave blank to propose it from the image, when possible
thermogram.deltaHint: The largest delta of the observed element, as the camera reads it
